candidate.answerReason: The odd-power terms cancel in f(7)+f(-7), leaving -10. Thus f(7)=-10-7=-17, agreeing with choice A.

methods.label: Add values at opposite inputs
methods.explanation:
All the nonconstant powers are odd. Replacing \(x\) by \(-x\) therefore reverses the sign of every nonconstant term, while the constant remains \(-5\). Adding the two expressions cancels all terms containing the unknown coefficients:
\[
f(x)+f(-x)=-5-5=-10.
\]
Taking \(x=7\) and using \(f(-7)=7\), we obtain
\[
f(7)=-10-f(-7)=-10-7=\boxed{-17}.
\]
The answer is choice \(\mathrm{A}\).
methods.levelReason: Odd-power sign rules and polynomial addition give a complete elementary solution without determining the coefficients.
